meta.name: conducting-cloud-incident-response
meta.description: Responds to security incidents in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) by performing identity-based containment, cloud-native log analysis, resource isolation, and forensic evidence acquisition adapted for ephemeral cloud infrastructure. Activates for requests involving cloud incident response, AWS security incident, Azure compromise, GCP breach, cloud forensics, or cloud identity compromise.

copy.tagline: 自动响应云环境中的安全事件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责云环境安全事件响应与取证
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle security incidents in cloud environments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你完成云安全事件响应：检测异常API调用、禁用泄露的访问密钥、隔离受感染的云资源、收集日志和磁盘快照作为证据，并生成事件报告。
howto.when: 当你提到云安全事件、AWS/Azure/GCP 安全事件、云取证或云身份泄露等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我的AWS访问密钥泄露了，怎么办？
say.note: Claude会指导你禁用密钥、隔离实例并收集证据。

say.text: Azure中检测到可疑登录，请帮我处理。
say.note: Claude会指导你禁用用户、撤销会话并分析日志。

say.text: GCP存储桶被公开了，如何取证？
say.note: Claude会指导你导出审计日志、快照磁盘并修复策略。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through cloud incident response: detect suspicious API calls, disable compromised access keys, isolate affected resources, collect logs and disk snapshots as evidence, and generate an incident report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention cloud security incidents, AWS/Azure/GCP security events, cloud forensics, or cloud identity compromise.

say_en.text: My AWS access key is compromised, what should I do?
Suspicious sign-in detected in Azure, please help.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to disable the user, revoke sessions, and analyze logs.

say_en.text: GCP bucket is public, how to forensically collect evidence?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to export audit logs, snapshot disks, and fix policies.
